name: Triple Inside Fire Zone
formation: 11P Gun Spread 2x2 vs Odd Front Fire Zone

summary.motive: Generate true 5-man pressure with a double-A linebacker blast while a defensive end secretly trades his rush lane for the rat zone that swallows hot answers.
summary.keyDefender: RDE executing the rat trade drop
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses must account for six potential rushers with five blockers, so the hot progression fires directly into the vacated defender sitting in the intermediate window.
summary.failureMode: The offensive line slides to pick up both A-gap blasts cleanly, leaving the QB a free boundary flat or the isolated weak-side slant against a one-high shell.

beats.title: 1. The Double-A Blast
beats.text: Both mugging linebackers trigger at full speed into opposite A-gaps. The Center and guards must split two simultaneous interior charges with no backside help committed.

beats.title: 2. The Rat Trade
beats.text: While five defenders swarm the pocket, the strong defensive end exits his rush lane on a smooth backward arc, trading his pass-rush rep for the free-release rat zone.

beats.title: 3. The Dig Into the Teeth
beats.text: The QB climbs the pocket and trusts his 12-yard dig to Z, unaware the vacated rusher is already squatting exactly where the route breaks.

beats.title: 4. Interior Convergence Sack
beats.text: With WILL occupying the running back protector, MIKE and NT converge on the step-up lane and bury the QB before the dig can develop.

relations.tell: The strong end loosens his stance and takes a lateral first step rather than an upfield punch, signaling the trade before the ball is even thrown.
